text: Legacy MNP_Demo_Slim: timers fire today (TimerSweepWorker every Worker:TimerSweepSeconds=5 calls pkg_timers.fn_fire_due); seed durations TT-REVIEW_ESCALATION 15s, TT-REVIEW_EXPIRY 30s, TT-ACTIVATION_WINDOW 45s.

Legacy workflow branches B-REQUESTED-CUSTOMER_CANCELLED-1 and B-ELIGIBLE-CUSTOMER_CANCELLED-1 (rules BR-039, BR-040) are unreachable: no activation is ever committed in REQUESTED or ELIGIBLE (DEF-PLS-015).
The carrier retry back-off and timeouts of the legacy .NET client are library defaults not stated in the repository (GAP-NET-004); only 4 attempts on persistent 5xx and 1 on 422 are documented.
